capacity_basis: KGF hourly bounds plus coke inventory
reference_mode_rule: raw route rows are scenario definitions; no fixed hours
caveat: Inverse of 1.285 t dry coal per t coke.

capacity_basis: 170 t iron ore feed per h represented limit
reference_mode_rule: raw public output is context only
caveat: Partial represented burden; pellets and direct ore are outside this balance.

capacity_basis: BF6 and BF7 hourly represented-sinter bounds
reference_mode_rule: raw 7.2 Mt liquid steel is scenario context
caveat: Coke is balanced separately; this is not a complete BF burden recipe.

capacity_basis: BOF hourly bound and material recipe
reference_mode_rule: scaled BOF band defines reference scenario
caveat: Companion scrap and explicit loss rows complete the represented recipe.

capacity_basis: 1.5 Mt per y consumer cap converted by horizon
reference_mode_rule: derived aggregate is scenario_definition
caveat: No residual scrap supply.

capacity_basis: material identity
reference_mode_rule: reporting identity only
caveat: Loss equals represented inputs minus liquid-steel output.

capacity_basis: HSM hourly capacity plus cold-slab inventory
reference_mode_rule: scaled HSM output band defines reference scenario
caveat: No fixed HSM/DSP share in endogenous mode.

capacity_basis: 5.4 Mt per y raw HSM output used once for conversion derivation
reference_mode_rule: raw 5.4 and derived aggregates are scenario_definition
caveat: Equivalent to 1.0416666667 t slab per t HRC.

capacity_basis: material identity
reference_mode_rule: reporting identity only
caveat: Explicitly reported and never reused as supply.

capacity_basis: 1.5 Mt per y final-output cap plus hourly equivalent
reference_mode_rule: scaled DSP output band defines reference scenario
caveat: Raw 20 percent route and raw 1.5 Mt output conflict remains visible; neither pair is imposed simultaneously.

capacity_basis: 1.5 Mt per y output cap
reference_mode_rule: raw 1.5 and derived aggregates are scenario_definition
caveat: Equivalent to 1.05 t liquid steel per t coil.

capacity_basis: hard cumulative 6.75 Mt per y proxy deadlines
reference_mode_rule: 6.75 target and all aggregates are scenario_definition
caveat: Raw 7.2 Mt per y is liquid-steel context and is not the active final-product denominator.

capacity_basis: KGF1 hourly bound plus coke inventory
reference_mode_rule: raw route rows are scenario definitions
caveat: Retained route only.

capacity_basis: retained sinter hourly represented limit
reference_mode_rule: raw route rows are scenario definitions
caveat: Partial represented burden.

capacity_basis: BF6 120-170 t represented activity per h
reference_mode_rule: retained BOF aggregate band defines reference scenario
caveat: Activity-to-hot-metal mapping only; this is not physical sinter consumption.

capacity_basis: Configuration-matched 2.8 Mt/y sinter and 2.8 Mt/y hot metal
reference_mode_rule: retained BOF aggregate band defines reference scenario
caveat: BF7 is inactive; 1.088 t sinter per t hot metal remains a predetermined offline sensitivity.

capacity_basis: BOF route capacity and 1.0 Mt per y scrap consumer guardrail
reference_mode_rule: narrow cumulative BOF band defines scenario
caveat: Companion 0.294 t scrap per t liquid steel row is separate.

capacity_basis: 1.0 Mt per y BOF consumer guardrail plus site cap
reference_mode_rule: derived aggregate is scenario_definition
endogenous_mode_rule: free within route and site caps
caveat: Does not duplicate the 1.9 Mt per y site supply cap.

capacity_basis: 550 t pellets per h and governed turndown and ramp
reference_mode_rule: aggregate DRP/EAF route output is scenario_definition
caveat: DRI buffer separates DRP from EAF.

capacity_basis: EAF activity bound plus DRI buffer
reference_mode_rule: narrow cumulative EAF band defines scenario
caveat: Companion scrap route is separate.

capacity_basis: 1.8 Mt per y EAF guardrail plus 1.9 Mt per y site cap
reference_mode_rule: derived aggregate is scenario_definition
endogenous_mode_rule: free within route and site caps
caveat: Central ratio is MER 0.9 over 3.3; 1.8 is an operational high-scrap guardrail.

capacity_basis: 1.9 Mt per y central site supply cap
reference_mode_rule: route aggregates are scenario_definition
caveat: Origin split is not invented.

capacity_basis: HSM hourly capacity and origin conservation
reference_mode_rule: narrow HSM and import bands define reference scenario
caveat: No fixed BF-BOF/DRP-EAF or HSM/DSP split in endogenous mode.

capacity_basis: HSM capacity and 6.75 final-product quota
reference_mode_rule: narrow HSM output band defines scenario
caveat: Equivalent to 1.06 t slab per t HRC and applied equally to every origin.

capacity_basis: material and origin identity
reference_mode_rule: reporting identity only
caveat: Loss is origin attributed and never reused as supply.

capacity_basis: 1.5 Mt per y output cap
reference_mode_rule: narrow DSP output band defines scenario
caveat: Equivalent to 1.05 t liquid steel per t coil; imported slab cannot enter DSP.

capacity_basis: 0.6 Mt per y cap converted to each horizon
reference_mode_rule: narrow imported-slab band defines reference scenario
caveat: Zero upstream site electricity WAG NG and CO2; downstream conversion applies normally.

capacity_basis: hard origin conservation identity
reference_mode_rule: all band-derived aggregates are scenario_definition
caveat: Origin residual must equal zero.

capacity_basis: hard cumulative 6.75 Mt per y proxy deadlines
reference_mode_rule: 6.75 target and band-derived aggregates are scenario_definition
caveat: Raw MER 6.8 liquid steel and 7.0 final product remain separate public contexts.

capacity_basis: source-backed PCI accounting flow linked to solved hot-metal output
reference_mode_rule: not an independent production anchor
endogenous_mode_rule: named external flow follows bounded hot-metal throughput
caveat: JRC Iron and Steel BREF central development coefficient; no burden substitution is introduced.

capacity_basis: source-backed PCI accounting flow linked to retained BF6 hot-metal output
reference_mode_rule: not an independent production anchor
endogenous_mode_rule: named external flow follows bounded hot-metal throughput
caveat: JRC Iron and Steel BREF central development coefficient; BF7 remains inactive.

capacity_basis: source-backed PEFA ore input linked to represented pellet output
reference_mode_rule: PEFA output row is reporting context
endogenous_mode_rule: named external ore follows represented PEFA output
caveat: JRC BREF Table 4.1 base candidate; internal pellets receive no purchase price.

capacity_basis: source-backed PEFA ore input linked to represented pellet output
reference_mode_rule: PEFA output row is reporting context
endogenous_mode_rule: named external ore follows represented PEFA output
caveat: JRC BREF Table 4.1 base candidate; no PEFA-to-DRP material connection is assumed.
